newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: China's Maoming hydrocracker to shut end March.
newsitem.headline: China's Maoming hydrocracker to shut end March.

text.p: China's state-owned refiner Maoming Petrochemical Corp is planning a one-month maintenance shutdown of its 800,000 tonnes-per-year (16,000-barrel-per-day) hydrocracker starting end March, sources familiar with the refinery said on Friday.
"The hydrocracker will be shut around the end of March for a month," one of the sources said.
The sources said three fluid catalytic crackers (FCC) with a total capacity of 800,000 tonnes per year have also been scheduled to close for maintenance in July.
They said no decision has yet been made on maintenance schedules of the refinery's three crude distillation units with a total capacity of 170,000 bpd.
